rules.sentence: Mucosal melanomas are macular or nodular lesions with pigmented brown-to-black coloration.
Kaposi sarcoma presents with focal or widespread violaceous-brown patches, papules, plaques, or exophytic nodules.
NHL often presents as a painless, submucosal mass at the junction of the hard and soft palates without ulceration and with cervical lymphadenopathy.
